clips.text: How to make a proper cup of tea. Six steps. No arguments.
Start with fresh water, and boil the kettle. Properly boiling. Not just warm and hopeful.
Put the tea bag in the mug first. Then pour the water straight on top.
Now wait. Three whole minutes. I know. But a rushed cup of tea is a sad cup of tea.
Take the bag out. One gentle squeeze against the side, and into the bin it goes.
Then the milk. Milk goes in last. We will not be taking questions on this.
And that's it. Sit down. Put your feet up. You've earned it.
